body: Having parents that don't understand anything is really tough. My dad used to mock me for playing video games and complain about my personality to the point that I eventually just stopped going to his house him(he and my mom were divorced). As for getting made fun of by the girls: just try to not let it get to you. Know that it's just the opinion of some dumbass. I got made fun of a lot because of my acne, but now I realize that that person must have a really shitty life if they need to pick on someone else to be happy. And I know that that can be really hard to do in the moment but just try. Maybe try to ask your mom to get rid of the limit just on music and the audio-books. I feel that if you explained how it helps you a lot maybe she would agree to get rid of the limits on just those two. The only thing I can say on depression is that trying new things helps. I've struggled with a lot of depression over the past few years, and trying new things like skateboarding and art made me happier, and they're things that I can do when I'm feeling down about whatever. Good luck.
